function.name: base64_encode
function.description:
Encode text to base64url — the format Gmail API body fields require.

The Gmail messages.send / drafts endpoints accept the message body only in
base64url form: either ``raw`` (the full RFC 2822 message, base64url-encoded)
or ``payload.body.data`` (the body text, base64url-encoded). Use this tool to
produce that encoding, then pass the result to api_fetch. This is a local
helper — it does not call any API endpoint.

text.description: Plaintext to encode (an email body, or a full RFC 2822 message).
text.title: Text

emails, alerts, and any other Gmail send/deliver/transmit action.

send outgoing email, send outbound message, deliver email, transmit

message send, send a new email, send notification email, send alert

function.name: search_tools
function.description:
Find available tools by name or description.

Tool names follow the pattern {service}_{action} (e.g., salesforce_query,
gmail_send_email, slack_send_channel_message).

Uses BM25 keyword-based relevance search. Works with service names,
action words, or multi-word queries.
Examples: "salesforce", "send email", "update deal", "slack channel"

query.description: Search query — service names, keywords, or a description.
query.title: Query

top_k.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 20).
top_k.title: Top K

function.name: execute_tool
function.description:
Execute a discovered tool by name with the given arguments.

Use search_tools first to find the right tool and its parameter schema,
then call this with the tool name and a JSON string of arguments.

tool_name.description: The exact tool name from search results.
tool_name.title: Tool Name

arguments.description: JSON string of arguments matching the tool's parameter schema.
arguments.title: Arguments
